 DRIVER BRIEFING

You drive.

Each qualifying round is an out-lap followed by one timed lap. You have three rounds; your fastest valid time counts. An invalid lap or ended run still uses that round.

Accelerate / brakeW / SSteer left / rightA / DShift down / upQ / EDRS / ERS, holdSPACE / SHIFTCamera / soundC / MPause practice / end qualifyingESCRecover car, practice onlyR

No driving assists. Wall bumps do not invalidate your lap or retire the car. Qualifying ends when you leave the tab. Ranked rounds are counted on the server and survive reloads.

DRS: one activation per lap on a clear track. Hold Space to open the wing; releasing, braking or substantial steering closes it and uses that activation. The allowance resets at the timing line. Release Space before activating on the next lap.
